title: Shared wire header ensures ioctl codes match between port and simulator
description: Both crypto2dev_port.c and crypto2dev_sim.c include crypto2dev_wire.h which defines wire structs and derives ioctl codes via _IOW/_IOR macros that encode sizeof(struct) into the request code. This means any field added/removed/resized in a wire struct will automatically change the ioctl code on both sides, making ABI breaks an immediate build failure rather than a runtime mismatch. A contributor might suggest moving the ioctl definitions inline into each file. Resist: the shared header is the only mechanism that guarantees the sim and the real driver use identical codes. Splitting them would allow one side to drift silently.
